[[File:Amy's saw detail.png|left|120px]]
'''Amy's saw''' is an equipable [[saw]] that can be bought from the [[Mahogany Homes Reward Shop]] for 500 [[Carpenter points]]. Unlike the [[crystal saw]], it does not provide any [[Construction]] level boost. 

The saw is wielded in the weapon slot. Its combat bonuses are comparable to bronze weapons—it falls between a [[bronze shortsword]] and [[bronze scimitar]] in offensive bonuses, but its [[attack speed]] is slightly slower.

The saw can be wielded in the [[Shield slot table|shield slot]] by converting it to its [[Amy's saw (off-hand)|off-hand variant]] via the "Swap" option, exactly the same as the [[Imcando hammer]]. This allows the player to wield both tools at the same time, conserving inventory space when using a [[Shipwrights' Workbench]], building furniture in their [[player-owned house]], or during the [[Mahogany Homes]] minigame.

It can be stored in a [[magic wardrobe]] in a player's [[costume room]].
